title: Mike Borgonzi: Carnell Tate is going to be great for Cam Ward

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Borgonzi: Carnell Tate is going to be great for Cam Ward
sources.description: The Titans picked up a pair of players on Thursday night, selecting receiver Carnell Tate out of Ohio State at No. 4 overall before trading back into the first round to select defensive end Kendrick Faulk out of Auburn at No. 31.
